review.why: Creates single-page posters and art in PNG or PDF from a written design philosophy, using bundled open fonts.
review.summary: Two steps: write a short design philosophy, then express it as one museum-style PNG or PDF with minimal text, a limited palette and fonts from a bundled folder of open-licensed typefaces. A final pass refines what exists instead of adding elements. A multi-page option makes a series from the same philosophy.
strengths: Bundled fonts come with their license files
Refinement step says to polish rather than add graphics
Hard rule that nothing overlaps or leaves the canvas
cautions: Output is abstract art with sparse text, a poor fit for informational posters
Tells the agent to download extra fonts if needed
